text: The rental terms are held as an addition to the asset table in rwb_asset by the DB story of this service: rental start date, tenant reference, rental term, rent, rent currency, payment method and auto-debit reference, with asset_ref and tenant_ref required and the other six optional. The rental step writes that set and holding_status = RENTED, and this story and its contract add no table, no column and no migration.
why: TSD S5 v2 T3.1 defines asset (DF-COL-028 to DF-COL-042) and asset_sale (DF-SAL-009 to DF-SAL-019) with no rental column, and no other source gives a physical set for the rental of R-DIS-25.
read: TSD S5 v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2; FSD S5 A2.24.3.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 R-DIS-25
applied_in: RWB-S5-E4033-APP s4 step 8, s11, s13; RWB-S5-E4033-CON s11, s12.1
confirm: Confirm with the S5 DB story owner and the solution architect before the wave 3 DB migration is baselined.
impact: If the DB story does not add the set, the APP story has no storage for the rental terms and its AC1 cannot be met.

text: The rwb-payment auto-debit request, the rwb-case case-move answer and the rwb-source-data asset read are consumed as class C dependencies with a placeholder operation name and the shape of the owner's published document, one hop and a 2 s budget. No name is invented and no amount, route state or ACE fact is held by this service.
why: No source publishes an operation name or request shape for these three rows, while the legacy key cannot be built without them.
read: Architecture v5 slide 13 (row S5: T to P7, T E to P8, T E to S9); TSD S5 v2 T-A.1; Ownership Map
applied_in: RWB-S5-E4033-APP s3, s4 steps 9 and 11, s12.2, s12.8; RWB-S5-E4033-CON s12.2, s12.8
confirm: Owner teams confirm the operation names before the wave 3 harness runs.
impact: The fakes carry the placeholder until confirmation; the app build is not blocked because the C row never blocks.

text: The auto-debit, the receipt, the arrears follow-up and the rental_arrears value of R-DIS-63 stay with rwb-payment (P8) under FEAT-PAY-09, and the arrears notice stays with rwb-comms (P6). This story requests them, holds a reference, and writes no amount, no instalment, no balance and no threshold value.
why: Architecture v5 slide 41 gives rwb-payment the fees, bookings and posting files; FSD P8 A2.9 already runs a rental auto-debit; R-DIS-63 gives a condition but no value, and no source assigns the follow-up to rwb-asset.
read: Architecture v5 slide 41; FSD P8 A2.9; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 R-DIS-63; Ownership Map (notice and template owner P6)
applied_in: RWB-S5-E4033-APP s2, s4 steps 9 and 10, s5, s8, s14, s19
confirm: Confirm with the P8 and P6 owners that the mandate, the follow-up and the notice are theirs.
impact: Keeps the money and the notices out of rwb_asset; a build that adds a balance column or an arrears value fails review.

text: ATS is an external system named by the Systems cell of R-DIS-25 and by FSD S5 A2.24.2, with no interface specification in TSD S5 T5.1. It is tracked and not built, configured, called or faked in this story.
why: TSD S5 v2 T5.1 lists INT-11 SVAF, INT-12 AMIS, INT-13 RPS and INT-27 HOME.SCB only, and no document specifies an ATS interface.
read: TSD S5 v2 T5.1; FSD S5 A2.24.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 R-DIS-25
confirm: Confirm with the integration owner whether ATS is delivered in a later wave.
impact: No ATS call appears in the contract; the debit is rwb-payment's and no interface is invented.
